入场.title: Enter
入场.intro: How elements appear. By default they animate from a "pre-entry" state back to the element's own look, so any CSS position or rotation you set on the element is preserved.

退场.title: Exit
退场.intro: How elements leave. Usually written as `@-0.4` (0.4 s before the scene ends).

强调.title: Emphasis
强调.intro: For elements already on screen: emphasize them when the narration reaches them. Also covers movement, color changes and content swaps.

数据.title: Data
数据.intro: Numbers, progress and charts. Number effects automatically keep decimal places and thousands separators.

镜头.title: Camera
镜头.intro: Applied to a whole container: push in, pan, 3D tilt, shake.

角色.title: Character
角色.intro: For stand-up portraits and little characters: switch poses, lip sync, nod, hop, walk.

手绘.title: Hand-drawn
手绘.intro: Hand-drawn annotation, loaded from `fx-ink.js`. Lines wobble a little, draw on in stroke order, and once drawn they "boil" (re-pose ten times a second). Put them on the element you annotate; shared params `color` (defaults to the skin accent), `w` (line width), `dur`, `boil=calm|lively|off`.

对话.title: Chat & code
对话.intro: The screens that keep appearing in AI videos, loaded from `fx-chat.js`: a chat window (`data-make="chat"`), a typed prompt, a terminal (`data-make="terminal"`), code (`data-make="code"`) and an agent cursor (`data-make="agent"`). They move like the real software: messages grow from the sender's corner, AI answers arrive in bursts, people type in uneven chunks.

图解.title: Diagrams
图解.intro: Relationship diagrams, loaded from `fx-diagram.js`: surround (`data-make="surround"`) and hub-and-spoke (`data-make="hub"`). The center never moves; only what surrounds it does.

形状.title: Shapes
形状.intro: Shape morphing, motion along a path and springy wiggles, loaded from `fx-shape.js` plus the matching GSAP plugins in `vendor/gsap-plugins/` (MorphSVG, MotionPath, CustomEase, CustomWiggle, now free for commercial use). Twelve built-in shapes (`data-make="shape"`): check cross circle square triangle star heart bolt arrow-up arrow-down play bulb.

声音.title: Sound
声音.intro: The sound layer, loaded from `fx-sound.js`. Once loaded, **every effect carries its own sound** (a pop for pop-ins, a thump for landings, a swish for slides, a whoosh for transitions, ticks for typing…), all synthesised in code with no audio files. Any effect takes `sfx=name` to use another sound or `sfx=none` to stay silent. The effect below places a sound where nothing moves on screen. Add `?play` to the URL to hear it in the preview; `node lib/sfx.mjs <project>` writes the effects track for the final film.

组件.title: Components
组件.intro: Used together with components generated by `data-make`.

转场.title: Transitions
转场.intro: Written on the **later** scene: `<section class="scene" data-in="blur-cross(dur=0.5)">`.

文字.title: Text
文字.intro: Made for text: shimmer, glitch, word swap, delete-and-retype, split-flap, stroke, echo.

剪纸.title: Papercut
剪纸.intro: Papercut / paper-craft collage style: unfold, cut open, tear, stick on, layers rising one by one, plus a handmade stop-motion feel at 12 fps. Pairs best with the `theme-paper` skin, but works with any skin.

粒子.title: Particles
粒子.intro: Canvas particles; requires loading the extra `fx-particles.js`. Write them on a canvas container made with `data-make="space"`: each effect is one layer of the canvas, stacked from bottom to top in the order written. Common parameters: `dur` (how long this layer lasts), `fade` / `out` (fade in / out seconds), `x` / `y` (center position in percent), `seed`.

3D.title: 3D
3D.intro: Real 3D scenes (three.js); requires loading the extra `vendor/three-fx.min.js` and `fx-3d.js`. Write them on a stage made with `data-make="stage3d"`: some effects put objects into the stage, others move the camera (`cam3d`, `orbit3d`). Common parameters for objects: `dur` (how long it exists), `fade` / `out` (fade in / out seconds), `px` / `py` / `pz` (placement), `s` (overall scale), `seed`.

立体.title: White 3D
立体.intro: Tactile 3D white-studio & grid-desk motion, loaded from `fx-desk3d.js` (paired with `theme-white3d` or `theme-white3d desk`). Provides extruded 3D phones (`phone3d`), thick double-sided cards (`card3d`), 6-face boxes (`box3d`), exploded isometric layer stacks (`layers3d`), curved card decks (`deck3d`), tilted floating card walls (`wall3d`) and mechanical split-flap counters (`flap3d`), with floor shadows linked to Z-height.

空间.title: Space
空间.intro: World canvas, camera and image-set moves; requires loading the extra `fx-world.js`. Put `data-world` on the root element and every scene becomes a station on one big canvas: changing scenes means the camera travels there. Camera effects need `data-world`; the focus and image-set effects work on any page.

舞台.title: Stage
舞台.intro: Stage-play parts for "presenter in front, scene behind, information as picture-in-picture" explainers; requires loading the extra `fx-stage.js`. Scene backdrops (`backdrop`), devices with on-screen content (`device`), full-screen illustration inserts, a choice panel (`menu`) and small full-body actors (`mini`). Use it without `data-world`: scenes hard-cut, and `data-in="mosaic"` changes the backdrop.

stats.skinsLine: **7** themes (violet tech · black-gold cinema · retro pixel · papercut collage · deep-space particles · studio · white 3D)

catalog.heading: Effect catalog ({nFx} effects + {nTrans} transitions)
catalog.note1: This section is generated from `fx.js` by `node gen-readme.mjs`. Do not edit it by hand.
catalog.note2: All effects accept the common parameters `dur` (duration), `ease` (easing) and `stagger`; the tables below list only each effect's own parameters.

effects.fade-in: Plain fade-in, the most restrained; for subtitles and secondary notes
effects.rise-in: Slide up from below + fade in, the most versatile entrance. Param: dist=offset in px
effects.drop-in: Drop in from above + fade in; for tags and badges
effects.slide-in: Slide in from one side. Params: dir=left/right/up/down (direction of motion), dist
effects.blur-in: Blur to sharp, appearing in place; for big titles and screenshot cards
effects.blur-rise-in: Blur + slide up + fade in, the standard cinematic title entrance
effects.scale-in: Scale up from slightly smaller into place, the standard entrance for cards and images. Param: from=starting scale
effects.pop-in: Pop: scale up from small with an overshoot bounce; for callout pills, icons, checks and crosses
effects.zoom-settle: Settle from an enlarged, blurred state (like a lens snapping into focus); for opening headlines
effects.wipe-in: Reveal with a mask wipe. Param: dir=right/left/up/down (direction the wipe advances)
effects.mask-rise: Text rises from beneath an invisible baseline (mask slide-up); the strongest title feel
effects.flip-in: Flip upright around the horizontal axis (3D); for card flips and revealing question cards
effects.tilt-in: Fly in tilted with perspective (a 3D card turning to face front from the side); for UI screenshots
effects.stamp-in: Stamp: slams down from very large and shakes when it lands; for conclusions, seals, checks and crosses
effects.drop-bounce: Falls from above the frame and bounces twice on landing; for stacking objects and pixel blocks
effects.swing-in: Swings down from the top edge like a hanging sign and settles
effects.focus-in: Letter-spacing tightens from very wide + blur to sharp; common for small English titles and subtitles
effects.grow-x: Grow from 0 along the horizontal axis (bars, dividers, progress bars). Param: origin=left/center/right
effects.grow-y: Grow from 0 along the vertical axis (bar charts). Param: origin=bottom/top
effects.fan-in: A stack of cards fans out from the center to their own positions (use with each:); final positions and angles follow your CSS
effects.type: Typewriter: types out character by character. Params: cps=characters per second, caret=1 to show the cursor
effects.draw: Line drawing: an SVG stroke is drawn along its path (connectors, arrows, circled callouts, line charts)
effects.pixel-in: Pixel-style entrance: appears in 4-5 discrete steps (not smooth); with each: it can assemble block lettering
effects.scramble: Scramble decode: each character first flickers through random glyphs (gray), then locks into the correct character (white) from left to right. Params: dur, chars=pool of scramble characters
effects.rise-out: Slide up and away + fade out
effects.drop-out: Slide down and away + fade out
effects.blur-out: Blur + fade out (recedes into the background)
effects.scale-out: Shrink + fade out. Param: to=ending scale (>1 means it grows as it disappears)
effects.slide-out: Slide out to one side. Param: dir
effects.pulse: Scale up briefly and back (a tap when the narration hits this word). Param: to=peak scale
effects.shake: Shake left and right (negation, errors, warnings)
effects.nod: A small up-and-down hop (character nod, icon bounce)
effects.blink: Blink a few times (cursor, warnings). Param: n=count
effects.color: Change text / background color. Params: to=color, bg=background color
effects.marker: Highlighter: a color block sweeps left to right across the bottom of the text. Params: color, h=block height in %
effects.underline: Underline grows from left to right. Params: color, w=thickness in px
effects.strike: A strikethrough sweeps across (the old plan is void)
effects.box: Highlight box: draws an outline around the element (circle the key point on a screenshot). Params: color, pad, w, r
effects.glow: Glow breathing: the halo lights up then fades. Params: color, n=count
effects.sheen: Shine sweep: a highlight sweeps diagonally across a card / button
effects.ping: Ripple: a ring expands from the element's center (click feedback, marking a location)
effects.spot: Spotlight: use with each:; the i-th child stays bright and slightly enlarged while the rest are dimmed. Param: i (1-based)
effects.float: Continuous up-and-down floating (idle feel). Params: amp=amplitude, period=seconds per cycle, dur=how long it lasts
effects.move: Move the element to another element's position (cursor moves to a button, a tag flies into a card). Params: to=#target or x, y
effects.click: Click: press-down shrink + ripple (use with the .fx-cursor component)
effects.swap: Swap content in place: fades itself out and fades the target element in. Param: to=#target
effects.squash: Card squash-and-spring: narrows horizontally then springs back (about 3 frames squash + 4 frames spring), often used together with a content swap. Param: to=narrowest ratio
effects.cycle: Hard-cut carousel over children: one visible at a time, switching to the next every `every` seconds (a thumbnail whose picture keeps changing). Params: every, loop=1 to loop, stop=which item to stop on
effects.text: Hard-cut text to new content (clock ticks, label changes). Param: v=new text
effects.to: Universal tween: write GSAP properties directly. Example: to@2(x=120,scale=1.2,opacity=0.5,dur=0.6,ease=inout)
effects.count: Number counter. Put the final number in the element, or set it with to=; from=starting value. Automatically keeps decimal places and thousands separators
effects.roll: Digit-by-digit vertical roll: each digit is a 0-9 vertical strip that scrolls with blur and then stops from left to right (the $7,000 in the black-gold theme). Params: dur, stagger, spins=extra full turns
effects.clock: Clock dial-in: from=23:28 to to=01:23 (crosses midnight automatically)
effects.fill: Progress bar fill: grows the element's width (or height with dir=y) from from% to to%
effects.ring: Ring progress: use with data-make="ring". Params: from, to (0-1)
effects.wave-live: Waveform jumping: use with data-make="wave"; each bar fluctuates randomly from a seed. Params: dur, seed
effects.push: Slow push-in (Ken Burns): the whole container scales up slightly at constant speed over time. Params: from, to, dur
effects.pan: Slow pan. Params: x, y (total displacement in px), dur
effects.zoom-to: Zoom to a region: scales and pans the container so the target area fills the frame. Params: to=#target or x,y,w,h (px inside the container), fill=fraction of the frame
effects.zoom-reset: Pull back from a close-up to the full view
effects.tilt: Place at a 3D tilt and slowly rotate (a floating UI card). Params: rx, ry start angles; rx2, ry2 end angles
effects.drift: Slow background drift (blurred card wall, particle layer). Params: x, y, rot, dur
effects.pose: Switch character pose: put several [data-pose] images in a .host and hard-cut to the one named by name (talking-head portraits are normally hard cuts); bounce=1 adds a squash-and-spring
effects.lipsync: Lip sync: hard-cuts between several [data-mouth] images in the container every `frames` frames (usually 2-4), returning to the first when done. Params: dur, frames, seed
effects.talk: Small up-and-down bobbing while talking. Params: dur=how long it talks, rate=bobs per second
effects.hop: Hop in place (surprise, joy). Params: h=height, n=count
effects.walk: Walk over: horizontal movement + a bounce per step. Params: x=displacement or to=#target, steps=number of steps; for pixel characters add ease=steps(8)
effects.step: Step navigation switch: use with data-make="steps"; lights up the i-th pill (1-based) and turns the rest off
effects.chapter: Chapter progress bar: use with data-make="chapters"; the highlight block slides to chapter i (1-based)
effects.check: Checklist tick: use with the .fx-check component; the check mark is drawn and the text turns solid
effects.转场/push: Push: the new scene pushes the old one out. Param: dir=left/right/up/down
effects.cut: Hard cut (default). The most common and fastest-paced
effects.blur-cross: Blur cross: the previous shot blurs and fades out while the next goes from blurred to sharp
effects.zoom-through: Zoom through: the previous shot scales up and rushes out of frame while the next scales up from small into place
effects.wipe: Wipe: the new scene covers the old one along a direction. Param: dir
effects.iris: Iris: the new scene expands from a point to full screen. Params: x, y (percent)
effects.flash: Flash to white (or any color): for key sentences and chapter openings. Param: color
effects.dip: Dip to black: fades to dark then back up (change of topic). Param: color
effects.pixelate: Pixel dissolve: blocks cover the screen in random order and then disperse (scene change for the pixel style). Params: cols, color
effects.文字/shimmer: Shimmer text: a highlight sweeps across the text from left to right (ShinyText). Params: color=highlight color, n=number of sweeps, gap=pause between sweeps
effects.文字/glitch: Glitch text: red/blue split + jitter + skew for a short burst, then settles (GlitchText). Params: amp=split in px, dur, seed. Note: it zeroes the element's x, so wrap the element in a shell if it needs to move itself
effects.文字/rotate-words: Word rotate: the word flips up and away, the next one flips in at the same spot (WordRotate). Params: words=B/C/D (separated by /, the element's original text is the first), every=seconds each word stays
effects.文字/morph: Morphing words: the old word blurs and disperses, the new one condenses out of the blur (MorphingText). Params: words=B/C, every
effects.文字/retype: Delete and retype: erases the existing text character by character from the end, then types the new text (TextType). Params: v=new text, cps=characters typed per second, del=characters deleted per second
effects.文字/true-focus: Word-by-word focus: only one word is sharp at a time, the rest blur, and a focus frame jumps to the active word (TrueFocus). For Chinese separate words with / (e.g. AI/won't/replace/you); English splits on spaces. Params: every, blur, color
effects.文字/split-flap: Split-flap board: each character flips through random glyphs, then settles on the right one from left to right (SplitFlap, airport departure board). Use as an entrance. Params: dur, stagger, chars=glyph pool
effects.文字/stroke-in: Stroke text: draws a hollow outline in one direction first, then fills in the color (StrokeText). Params: w=stroke width, color=stroke color, hold=seconds to stay hollow
effects.文字/echo: Echo entrance: several translucent copies trail behind and slide in together, then fade away once in place (EchoText). Params: n=number of echo layers, dist, dir
effects.入场/light-speed-in: Light-speed entrance: rushes in from one side with a skew, overshoots, then straightens (animate.css lightSpeedIn). Params: dir=left|right (direction of motion), dist
effects.入场/jack-in: Jack-in-the-box: pops up gradually from the bottom, wobbles left and right twice and settles (animate.css jackInTheBox)
effects.退场/hinge: Hinge drop: pinned at the top-left corner, it swings twice, then falls out of frame (animate.css hinge). Param: dist
effects.退场/fall-out: Falling text: each character tumbles down out of frame with some rotation (FallingText); usually used with chars:. Params: dist, seed
effects.强调/tada: Tada: shrinks slightly, then scales up and sways left and right (animate.css tada)
effects.强调/jello: Jello: skews back and forth with decreasing amplitude (animate.css jello)
effects.强调/rubber-band: Rubber band: stretches horizontally, squashes vertically, and bounces a few times (animate.css rubberBand)
effects.强调/heartbeat: Heartbeat: two quick scale-ups in a row (animate.css heartBeat)
effects.强调/head-shake: Head shake: a left-right shake with a bit of 3D rotation (for "no" or "wrong") (animate.css headShake)
effects.强调/wobble: Wobble: translates while tilting back and forth (animate.css wobble)
effects.强调/border-beam: Border beam: a short streak of light runs around the element's border (BorderBeam / StarBorder). Params: color, w=thickness, len=beam length as a fraction of the perimeter, n=laps, dur=seconds per lap, keep=1 to stay visible after finishing
effects.强调/spotlight: Spotlight: dims the screen and leaves one circular bright area over the target; calling it again in the same scene moves the spot to the new target (Spotlight). Put it on the element to light, or use to=#id. Params: r=radius, dim=darkness 0~1, off=1 to turn it off
effects.强调/confetti: Confetti: bursts a handful of confetti from the element's center, tossed up and falling back down (Confetti / ClickSpark). Params: n, colors=c1/c2/c3, power, seed
effects.强调/sparkle: Sparkle: little stars pop up at random around the element and twinkle (SparklesText). Params: n, color, dur, seed
effects.强调/orbit: Orbit: spreads the container's children evenly on a circle and rotates them around the center while keeping each child upright (OrbitingCircles). Put it on the container. Params: r=radius, turns=number of turns, dur, reverse=1 to reverse
effects.强调/beam: Connecting beam: draws an arc between two elements and a glow flows along it (AnimatedBeam, good for "A sends data to B"). Put it on the start element, to=#end. Params: curve=curvature, color, n=number of flows, dur
effects.强调/flip-swap: Flip and swap: the element flips around its vertical axis, the back shows the second child, then flips back (flip cards, reveal an answer). Put two children inside: the first is the front, the second is the back. Param: axis=y|x
effects.镜头/meteors: Meteor shower: streaks of light slanting across the screen (Meteors); put it on a full-bleed background layer. Params: n, angle=direction in degrees (default 135 = toward bottom-left), color, dur, seed
effects.镜头/marquee: Marquee: a row of content scrolls horizontally in an endless loop (Marquee / LogoLoop). Put it on a single-row container; children are duplicated automatically to fill the width. Params: speed=px per second, reverse=1 to reverse
effects.镜头/bg-scroll: Background pattern scroll: keeps the background (grid, texture, stripes) translating at a set speed; use it with the retro-grid component. Params: x, y=px per second
effects.镜头/parallax: Parallax: layers inside the container translate at different speeds by order (back layers move less, front layers more); use it with the hills layered paper hills. Put it on the container. Params: x, y=total displacement of the front layer, dur
effects.剪纸/paper-unfold: Paper unfold: like folded paper opening flat from the crease, with a bit of rebound. Param: dir=down|up|left|right (direction of unfolding)
effects.剪纸/cut-in: Scissor cut: "cuts" the element out snip by snip along a zigzag edge, advancing frame by frame for a papercut feel. Params: dir=right|left|down|up, teeth=number of teeth, jag=tooth depth (%), snips=number of cuts
effects.剪纸/peel-in: Corner peel: a sticker lifted at one corner settles back and is pressed flat. Param: corner=tl|tr|bl|br (which corner)
effects.剪纸/layer-rise: Layer rise: paper layers in the container rise from below one after another, back to front; the nearer the layer, the later and farther it rises (layered paper hills, paper stage). Put it on the container. Params: dist, stagger
effects.剪纸/stick-on: Sticker slap: slaps onto the paper from in front of the camera with a big shadow that tightens on landing (labels, photos). Params: from=starting scale, rot=starting tilt angle
effects.剪纸/stop-in: Stop-motion entrance: jumps in at the pace of 12 fps stop-motion, each frame with a random bit of tilt (handmade animation feel). Params: dist, steps=number of jumps, fps, seed
effects.剪纸/jitter: Stop-motion jitter: keeps tilting and shifting slightly at 12 fps, as if shot frame by frame by hand (boiling). Best added to an outer container so it does not fight an entrance effect for position. Params: amp=angle, px=offset, fps, dur
effects.剪纸/lift: Paper lift: floats up slightly while the shadow grows larger and fainter, as if pinched up by a finger; down=1 puts it back. Param: dist
effects.剪纸/flutter: Flutter: like a paper caught by a gust, it swings side to side a few times and slowly settles. Params: deg, n=number of swings, origin
effects.剪纸/sway: Hanging sway: hanging things (lanterns, tags, window flowers) keep swaying slowly left and right. Params: deg, period=seconds per swing, dur
effects.转场/paper-slide: Paper pull: a new sheet slides in from one side over the old one, with a shadow along the edge and the old sheet slightly darkened. Param: dir=left|right|up|down
effects.转场/tear: Paper tear: the new scene is revealed from one side along a jagged torn edge (papercut-style scene change). Params: dir=right|left|down|up, jag, teeth
effects.转场/glitch-cut: Glitch cut: the new scene flickers a few times with a red/blue split, then stabilizes (tech-style cut)
effects.转场/open: Doors open: the new scene opens outward from a slit in the middle. Param: dir=x (opens left/right)|y (opens up/down)
effects.粒子/starfield: Starfield: stars fly toward the camera from far away (with speed=0 it is a static twinkling sky). Params: n, speed, streak=trail length (1 or more makes a warp-speed beam), size, colors=color1/color2
effects.粒子/nebula: Nebula: a few large soft clouds of colored haze drift slowly; use it as the bottom-most background. Params: n=number of clouds, colors, alpha=density
effects.粒子/vortex: Particle vortex: particles surge from the center toward the camera along spiral arms, with glowing streamlines (a space-time tunnel). Params: arms=number of arms, n, speed, twist=number of turns, spin=overall rotation speed, r=outer radius, colors (alternate per arm), lines=0 turns streamlines off
effects.粒子/blackhole: Black hole: black disc + glowing halo + tilted accretion disk; particles orbit faster on the inner ring and slower on the outer one, and the near half passes in front of the hole. Params: r=hole radius, tilt=how flattened the disk is, rot=tilt angle, n, speed, c1=inner color, c2=outer color
effects.粒子/orb: Energy orb: a glowing sphere built from triangular shards, slowly spinning with a bright core; it can gather from scattered shards into a sphere, or blow apart. Params: r=radius, detail=subdivision (1=80 shards, 2=320 shards), gap=gap between shards, spin, in=gather seconds, explode=second at which it blows apart, c1=lit-face color, c2=dark-face color, edge=outline color, core=core color
effects.粒子/burst: Explosion: a cloud of particles and triangular shards blows out from the center with a white flash and a shockwave ring, slowing down until it fades away. Params: n, power=force, shards=share of shards 0~1, life=duration in seconds, colors, ring=0 turns the shockwave off, flash=0 turns the flash off
effects.粒子/form-text: Particle text: tumbling little squares fly in from all sides and assemble a line of text (Chinese or English). Params: text, size=font size, font, weight, color, n=max particle count, start=how long they drift first, conv=gather seconds, glow=0 turns the text halo off, spacing=letter spacing in px
effects.粒子/stream: Particle stream: trailing points of light flow sideways across the frame along wavy streamlines (data flow, signals). Params: n, speed, amp=wave amplitude, waves=number of waves across, tail=trail length, colors, reverse=1 reverses direction
effects.3D/stars3d: 3D starfield: a large cloud of stars scattered through space, with depth layers as the camera moves. Params: n, r=spread radius, size, colors
effects.3D/galaxy3d: Spiral galaxy: tens of thousands of particles arranged in spiral arms rotating around the center, faster inside and slower outside. Params: n, arms=number of arms, r=radius, inner=empty radius at the center, spin=rotation speed, twist=how much the arms curve, colors (alternate per arm), size, bright
effects.3D/orb3d: 3D energy orb: a sphere built from metallic triangular shards with real lighting and a glowing core; the shards can gather from scattered pieces into a sphere, or blow apart. Params: r=radius, detail=subdivision (1=80 shards, 2=320 shards), gap=gap between shards, spin, in=seconds to gather, explode=at which second to blow apart, power=blast strength, color=shard color, emissive=self-glow color, core=core color
effects.3D/tunnel3d: Particle tunnel: particles and light rings line up in a tunnel rushing toward the camera (put the camera inside the tunnel looking down it). Params: n, r=tunnel radius, len=length, speed, twist=how much it spirals, rings=number of rings (0 for none), colors
effects.3D/waves3d: Wave grid: a large ground of dots that undulates like water. Params: nx / nz=number of dots, w / d=width and depth, amp=wave height, freq=wave density, speed, c1=color at the troughs, c2=color at the crests
effects.3D/globe3d: Dot globe: a sphere made of dots that rotates slowly, with arcs of light flying between pairs of points on its surface (global network, data links). Params: r=radius, n=number of dots, arcs=number of arcs, spin, color=dot color, arc=arc color
effects.3D/blackhole3d: 3D black hole: a black sphere + a light ring that always faces the camera + a particle accretion disk; the camera can orbit around it. Params: r=black hole radius, n, disk=outer radius of the disk (multiple of r), speed, c1=inner color, c2=outer color
effects.3D/burst3d: 3D explosion: tens of thousands of particles blast outward in every direction, slowing as they fly, with one strong flash. Params: n, power=strength, life=duration in seconds, colors
effects.3D/text3d: 3D particle text: particles in space converge from all directions into a line of text with thickness, and the camera can circle it (Chinese and English both work). Params: text, w=text width in the scene, depth=number of thickness layers, start=how long they drift first, conv=seconds to converge, color, n=max particle count, font, weight, scatter=scatter radius
effects.3D/city3d: City: a street lined with buildings on both sides, lit windows, outlined walls, headlights flowing along the road, and an optional setting sun at the far end. Pair it with cam3d to fly down the street. The street runs along -z. Params: rows=how many rows deep, cols=how many columns per side, road=road width, lit=fraction of lit windows, colors=window colors, wall=wall color, edge=outline color (edge=0 for no outline), sun=sun color (sun=0 for none), traffic=0 turns off the traffic
effects.3D/cam3d: Move the camera: fly from the current position to a new one while turning the view toward a new target. Params: x / y / z=where to fly to, lx / ly / lz=where to look, fov=field of view, dur, ease (dur=0 cuts straight there). Any parameter you omit stays unchanged
effects.3D/orbit3d: Orbit camera: the camera circles a target, optionally moving in or rising at the same time. Params: turn=degrees to turn (negative goes the other way), from=start angle (omit to start from the current position), r=distance from the target at the end, h=height at the end, lx / ly / lz=what to circle around, dur, ease
effects.退场/scatter-out: Scatter burst exit: elements fly outward in all directions with rotation and parabolic gravity (great for clearing clutter or busting myths). Params: power=force, dur, seed
effects.强调/circuit: Orthogonal circuit link: draws a Manhattan right-angled trace between two elements and sends glowing data packets along it (architecture diagrams, protocol flows). Put it on the start element, to=#end. Params: mid=bend ratio, packets=pulse count, color, dur
effects.强调/overload: Overload alarm: rapid jitter + flashing red warning glow (context overflow, system overload, errors). Params: amp, color, dur, seed
effects.强调/scan: Laser scanline: a glowing scanner band sweeps across a window or card (code reading, document retrieval, chart diagnostics). Params: dir=down|right, color, n=count, dur
effects.强调/callout: Leader-line callout: pulls an angled leader line from an element's edge and pops a text label (chart peaks, key data notes). Params: text, dx, dy, color
effects.组件/toggle: Flip switches: pair with data-make="switches" to flip switch i (supports 2/3/5 batch) ON (on=1) or OFF (on=0). Params: i, on=0|1, stagger
effects.角色/rig-idle: Soft rig breathing: drives natural chest breathing, subtle hair sway, and seeded blinking on any bound SVG character. Params: dur, seed
effects.角色/rig-pose: Soft rig pose: smoothly transitions to a named pose or IK hand targets (lx, ly, rx, ry) with seamless continuous Bezier sleeves. Params: pose, lx/ly/rx/ry, look, face, emote, dur
effects.角色/rig-talk: Multi-viseme lip-sync: cycles naturally through [data-viseme] mouth shapes with subtle head rhythm, returning to the resting mouth when done. Params: dur, frames, nod=1, seed
effects.角色/rig-nod: Soft nod / head-shake: drives neck pivot and triggers spring follow-through on hair and accessories. Params: shake=1 (head-shake), n, amp, dur
effects.角色/rig-wave: Soft arm wave: arcs the IK hand target back and forth on a soft limb (arm=R|L) so the entire sleeve sways fluidly. Params: arm=R|L, n, amp, dur
effects.转场/shatter: 3D shatter: fractures the frame into 3D shards that tumble and fall away to reveal the next scene. Params: cols, colors=c1/c2, dur, seed
effects.转场/diagonal-split: Diagonal slash split: a glowing diagonal slash cuts the frame and pulls apart to reveal the next scene. Params: angle, color, dur
effects.转场/blinds: Venetian blinds: slices the incoming scene into slats that flip open in a wave over the previous scene. Params: n=slats, dir=x|y, dur
effects.转场/crt-off: Retro CRT switch: collapses the outgoing scene into a bright horizontal scanline before flashing open the next scene. Params: color, dur
effects.转场/portal-spin: Vortex spin: twists the outgoing scene into the center while untwisting the incoming scene into focus. Params: deg, dur
effects.转场/halftone: Comic halftone wave: a grid of dots expands diagonally to cover the screen and shrinks away to unveil the next scene. Params: cols, color, dur
effects.角色/vrm3d: 3D VRM anime avatar: loads any standard .vrm model onto a stage3d (MToon cel-shading + 54 humanoid bones + 5-vowel lip-sync + deterministic SpringBone hair physics). Params: src, ry, x/y/z, s, breathe/blink/sway/spring
effects.角色/vrm-pose: 3D VRM pose & expression: smoothly blends across 13 full-body anime presenter poses (idle, wave, explain, point, point-up, think, shock, clasp, reject, shrug, proud, cheer, bow), facial expressions (neutral, happy, relaxed, angry, sad, surprised), and eye gaze (look=cam|right|left|up|down, ry)
effects.角色/vrm-talk: 3D VRM 5-vowel lip-sync: drives aa/ih/ou/ee/oh morph targets with seeded syllable pauses and subtle speech head rhythm. Params: dur, rate, amp, seed
effects.角色/vrm-nod: 3D VRM head nod/shake/tilt: layers an additive 3D head/neck impulse on top of the active pose. Params: kind=nod|shake|tilt, n, amp, dur
effects.角色/vrm-move: 3D VRM stage move: translates or pops the 3D avatar root (e.g. pop-in from bottom or side step). Params: x/y/z, fromY, dur, ease
effects.角色/vrm-anim: 3D VRM mocap clip: plays standard .vrma (VRM Animation) motion-capture files deterministically on the timeline. Params: src, dur
effects.空间/cam-look: Camera pushes in on one element inside the station (use it when the voice-over reaches that element); follow with `cam-home` to pull back. Params: to (selector, defaults to the element itself), fit (how much of the frame it should fill, default 0.6), max (maximum zoom, default 1.4), dur
effects.空间/cam-home: Camera returns to the full view of the current station (use after `cam-look`). Param: dur
effects.空间/cam-wide: Camera pulls out to show the whole canvas (opening overview, closing recap). Written as `cam-wide@0` the film starts on the overview; push in with `cam-home`. Param: dur
effects.空间/wake: Place first, talk later: the element is on screen from the start but dimmed, and lights up when mentioned. Params: dim (brightness before it lights up, default 0.3), solid=1 (darken and desaturate instead of fading, so a card never shows the backdrop through it; on automatically in stage mode)
effects.空间/zoom-here: In-place zoom: pick one item out of a group and enlarge it where it sits while the rest fade to 30% and step back. Params: s (scale, default 2.4), hold (seconds before it returns automatically; omit to keep it), dim
effects.空间/push-back: Background blur: when new content arrives, push the previous layer back as a whole (scale to 94%, blur 4px, darken to 55%). Params: s, blur, dim, dur
effects.空间/bring-front: Bring back a layer that `push-back` pushed away
effects.空间/depth: Depth layers: children carry `data-depth="near|mid|far"`; the farther from focus the blurrier (0 / 4 / 8px), with per-layer parallax drift. Params: focus (which layer is sharp, default mid), shift (parallax amount, default 40), blur
effects.空间/rack-focus: Rack focus: move the sharp layer to another one (used with `depth`). Params: to=near|mid|far, dur
effects.空间/bg-tint: Background colour swap: when the image changes, the whole background changes to its dominant colour so viewers see the switch at a glance. Params: color (`reset` restores the original), dur (default 0.5), to (element to tint, defaults to the whole canvas)
effects.空间/skeleton: Skeleton fill: a complex interface first appears as grey skeleton blocks, then real content fills in block by block in reading order. Put it on the container; its children are the blocks. Params: gap (delay between blocks, default 0.15), hold (how long the skeleton stays first, default 0.5)
effects.空间/deal-in: Deal-in: a set of images does not appear at once; they fly in one after another along an arc to their places. Use with `each:`. Params: stagger (default 0.1), from=left|right, dur
effects.空间/drop-gather: Drop and gather: a pile of images drops from above, gathers into a fan, keeps only the few to be discussed and lets the rest fall away. Put it on the container; add `data-keep` to children to keep (otherwise the first `keep` are kept). Param: keep (default 3)
effects.空间/fly: Depth tunnel: the camera flies continuously inward; the item it passes scales up and blurs, the next fades in from the depth. Put it on `data-make="tunnel"`. Params: to (fly to which item, counted from 1), each (seconds per item, default 0.7)
effects.空间/helix-spin: Helix: the camera orbits a cylinder of images, fast then slow, then keeps turning slowly. Put it on `data-make="helix"`. Params: turn (degrees of the fast turn, default 300), dur (fast-turn time, default 2.4), slow (degrees per second afterwards, default 10)
effects.空间/flip-to: 3D flip board: panels roll upward one after another, each flipping around the horizontal axis; the one facing the camera shows in full colour, the rest dim to 30%. Put it on `data-make="flipboard"`. Params: i (flip to which panel, counted from 1), dur
effects.空间/pick: Lift and make way: in a fan of images, the one being discussed lifts and enlarges while its neighbours slide aside; all others stay visible. Put it on `data-make="fan"`. Params: i (which one, counted from 1; 0 = put all back), s (default 1.3), gap (how far the others move, default 90), lift (default 70)
effects.空间/slice-to: Slice swap: the new image is cut into strips that grow up from the bottom one by one, with the number label flipping in sync. Put it on `data-make="slices"`. Params: i (which image, counted from 1; omit for the next one), stagger (default 0.07), dur
effects.空间/road-walk: Walk into the picture: the camera moves along a road close to the ground; each step lights up as it is reached. Put it on `data-make="road"`. Params: i (walk to which step, counted from 1), dur
effects.空间/bignum: Chapter card entrance: the big number drops in, the title slides out after it. Put it on `data-make="bignum"`. Param: dock (seconds before it shrinks into a small top-left label; omit to keep it)
effects.空间/segment: Progress line advances to segment i (counted from 1). Put it on `data-make="segments"`, usually in a persistent overlay layer
effects.转场/cam-to: World canvas only (default): the camera travels diagonally to the next station, pulling back slightly first, slow-fast-slow. Params: dur (0.6–0.9), arc (extra degrees swung on the way, default 8), pull (pull-back amount, default 0.07)
effects.转场/cam-jump: World canvas only: the camera jumps straight to the next station (hard cut); only for major chapter changes
effects.角色/pup-talk: Sprite talks: swaps the three mouth frames from a mouth track while the head sways with the volume. Put it on `data-make="puppet"`, or target an actor with `who=name`. Params: dur (how long, defaults to the end of the scene); the track comes from `FX.mouthTrack = { fps, frames }` (produced by your voice tool), otherwise it is generated
effects.角色/pup-nod: Sprite nods once (a listener agreeing, a speaker stressing a point). Put it on `data-make="puppet"`, or use `who=name`. Param: amp (default 1)
effects.角色/pup-lean: Sprite leans its whole body to one side (toward the person speaking). Put it on `data-make="puppet"`, or use `who=name`. Params: deg (positive leans right, 0 returns upright), dur
effects.角色/pup-emote: A hand-drawn emotion mark pops up above the sprite's head. Put it on `data-make="puppet"`, or use `who=name`. Params: kind=question|exclaim|sweat|anger|sparkle|idea|heart|zap|dots, hold (seconds, default 1.6)
effects.角色/pup-idle: Just keeps the sprite alive (blinking, breathing, slow head sway) without talking. Put it on `data-make="puppet"`; not needed if any of pup-talk / pup-nod / pup-lean / pup-emote is used
effects.角色/call: Calls an actor over to this element (use it when the element is being discussed): the actor ducks where it is and pops up next to this element. Put it on the element being discussed; on a `<section>` it sends the actor back to its home. Params: who (actor name), at=top|left|right|below (default top: peeks over the element's top edge), size (default 340 for top, 420 otherwise), align (left-right position for at=top, 0–1), dx, dy, flip=1 (mirror so it faces the content), pose (switch pose at the same time)
effects.角色/dismiss: Makes an actor duck out of frame (when the whole frame should go to the content). Param: who
effects.舞台/cutaway: Illustration insert: a full-screen picture cuts in hard, pushes in very slowly, then cuts back out; it covers the actors while subtitles and the chapter bar stay. Put it on an `` inside the scene. Params: dur (hold, 1.2–2.5 s), zoom (default 1.07), x / y (pan in percent), under=1 (sit below the actors so the presenter keeps talking over it; good for full-screen screen recordings)
effects.舞台/screen-to: On-screen cut: the content inside a device screen hard-cuts to item i (counted from 1; omit for the next one) with a faint flash. Put it on `data-make="device"`
effects.舞台/dive: Dive into the screen: the device zooms toward the camera until its screen fills the frame (give the next scene the same picture as its backdrop and it feels like walking into the screen). Put it on `data-make="device"`, usually in the last 0.5 s of the scene. Param: dur (default 0.5)
effects.舞台/frames: Frame-sequence playback: plays a series of stills as video (gameplay, screen recordings), frame-accurate. Put `data-frames="dir/f_%03d.jpg" data-n="count"` on the element. Params: fps (default 15), dur (defaults to the end of the scene; loops)
effects.舞台/choose: Pick an option: the highlight bar of a choice panel jumps to item i and ticks it. Put it on `data-make="menu"`. Params: i (counted from 1; `2/4/1/3` makes several quick picks in a row), every (interval between quick picks, default 0.28 s)
effects.舞台/mini-walk: A mini actor walks over: two alternating walk frames plus horizontal movement, then stands still. Put it on `data-make="mini"`. Params: x (distance, negative goes left) or to=#target, dur, step (seconds per step, default 0.16)
effects.舞台/mini-pose: A mini actor switches action (raise hand, cheer, sit…) with a small squash-and-bounce. Put it on `data-make="mini"`. Params: name (an action listed in `data-poses`), hold (seconds before returning to idle; omit to keep it)
effects.角色/pup-pose: Sprite pose change (hard cut, with an automatic blink and a tiny bounce at the swap). Put it on `data-make="puppet"`, or target an actor with `who=name`. Params: pose, pop=0 (no bounce)
effects.转场/mosaic: Mosaic scene change: paper-coloured blocks cover the frame roughly top to bottom in random order, then uncover the new scene at random; the blocks sit below the actors and persistent overlays, so the presenter is never covered (use for chapter or backdrop changes). Params: cols (blocks per row, default 24), color, dur, seed
effects.角色/closeup: Face close-up (reaction shot): hard-cuts to this actor's face, large, on a radial-burst background, holds, then hard-cuts back. Works with the existing bust sprites, no new art needed. Put it in the `data-fx` of the `<section>`. Params: who (actor name), dur (hold, default 1.1), pose (pose / expression during the close-up), kind (emotion mark to pop at the same time), color (background, default orange; also red / blue / green / purple), size (zoom size, default 1300)
effects.声音/sfx: Play one sound effect on its own (it sounds even when nothing moves on screen). Params: kind=pop|tick|click|swish|whoosh|thump|snap|hit|ding|chime|blip|rise|fall|buzz|sparkle|zap|glitch|paper|flap|card|rumble|swellup|shimmer|type|roll|step|dots, vol (volume multiplier), pitch (pitch multiplier), dur (seconds, for sustained sounds)
effects.镜头/cam: In a one-take film, a camera move inside a room: pan, push in, soften the background. Put it on the scene. Params: x / y (screen pixels; positive looks right / down), z (push-in factor, 1 is neutral), blur (background blur in pixels), to=#element (aim at it; pull=0.5 goes halfway), reset=1 to return to neutral, dur
effects.镜头/shot: In a one-take film, change the camera position mid-scene: push into a room, or pull back to the wide shot outside the building. Put it on the scene. Params: room=number|all, dur
effects.镜头/push-into: Push into a picture: the element first appears as a framed photo, the camera pushes in until it fills the screen, holds, then pulls back out. Put it on an absolutely positioned image inside the scene (left/top/width/height). Params: dur (total seconds from the push to the end of the pull), in / out (seconds for the push and the pull), cast=keep (characters stay), stay=1 (the frame remains after pulling out)
effects.手绘/ink-circle: Hand-draw a loop around the element (pen starts at the upper left and overshoots a little), with an optional note beside it. Params: label (the note), at=right|left|top|bottom (where the note goes), pad (how much larger than the element, default 18), color, w, dur
effects.手绘/ink-underline: Hand-drawn lines: squiggly underline, strike-through, left bracket. Params: kind=squiggle|double|strike|bracket, color, w, dur
effects.手绘/ink-box: Hand-draw a box around the element, with an optional tab label at the top left. Params: label, pad (default 14), color, w, dur
effects.手绘/ink-arrow: Draw a hand-drawn arrow from this element to another. Params: to=#target (or dx / dy offsets in pixels), tx / ty (which point inside the target, 0–1; omit to point at the nearest point on the target's edge), curve=straight|gentle|swoop, side=1|-1 (which way it bends), gap (space left at both ends), color, w, dur
effects.手绘/ink-mark: Vox-style annotation: a marker stroke on one word of a sentence while a thin line draws out to a short note. Params: word (the word to mark; omit to mark the whole element), style=highlight|circle|underline|scribble, note (the note; omit for the mark alone), color, dur
effects.对话/msg: One chat message arrives, growing from the sender's corner in 0.12 s. Put it on data-make="chat". Params: i (which message, counted from 1)
effects.对话/typing: The "typing…" bubble: three dots pop in where message i will appear and leave after dur seconds (usually followed by msg / stream-in for the same message). Put it on data-make="chat". Params: i, dur (default 1.2)
effects.对话/stream-in: An AI answer arrives in bursts the way streamed tokens do; fresh text lands grey and inks to full colour over 0.27 s. Put it on data-make="chat" (message i) or on any block of text. Params: i, speed (default 1)
effects.对话/prompt: Type into a prompt like a person: one to three characters at a time with uneven pauses; the caret blinks while typing and stays on after. Put it on an element that holds only text (add class="fx-prompt" for an input box). Params: fix (a mistyped word, typed first, deleted and corrected), glyph (leading glyph, default ›, none to hide), speed
effects.对话/run: Run a command in a terminal: type it, pause a beat, print the output line by line, then show a fresh prompt. Put it on data-make="terminal". Params: every (seconds between output lines, default 0.22), speed (typing speed)
effects.对话/diff: A code change: lines to remove turn red and collapse, lines to add turn green and expand. Put it on data-make="code" (lines starting with "- " are removed, "+ " added)
effects.对话/code-focus: A highlight band sweeps across one line of code and the other lines dim. Put it on data-make="code". Params: i (line number as finally shown, from 1; 0 restores all)
effects.对话/agent-go: Agent cursor: the name tag types out what the agent is about to do, then the cursor moves to the target and clicks with a ripple. Put it on data-make="agent"; write it several times in a row. Params: to=#target (omit to stay), say (text on the tag), click=0 (no click), done=1 (a check mark for a finished step)
effects.图解/surround-in: The center settles, then the chips around it arrive one by one; with close=1 they then close in together while the edges darken. Put it on data-make="surround". Params: gap (seconds between chips, default 0.3), close=1
effects.图解/overwhelm: A crowd of chips rushes in from every side, faster and faster, and crowds the still center (overload, too much at once). Put it on data-make="surround" (labels cycle through data-chips). Params: n (8–24, default 16), intensity (0.5–2: higher packs tighter and faster), dur (how long the rush takes, default 2.2)
effects.图解/hub-node: Node i of a hub diagram: its connector draws out from the center and the node pops on. Put it on data-make="hub", one per node as the narration reaches it. Params: i (from 1)
effects.舞台/dither-in: The picture resolves from two-tone pixel noise to clear (like an old console booting or a signal locking on). Put it on a data-make="backdrop"; with data-dither it ends as pixel art, otherwise on the original picture. Params: dur (default 1.6)
effects.舞台/light-sweep: A soft diagonal light sweeps across once (a premium touch for a conclusion, a product or a ranking). Put it on a scene, a backdrop or any element. Params: dur (default 1.6), angle (band angle, default 115), color, strength (0–1, default 0.5)
effects.舞台/light-leak: A film light leak: warm light washes in from one side and fades (memories, turns, emotional peaks). Put it on a scene or a backdrop. Params: dur (default 4), tone=warm|cool, strength (0–1, default 0.9)
effects.形状/shape-morph: A shape smoothly turns into another (✗ into ✓, a circle into a star…), optionally changing colour. Put it on data-make="shape" or on any svg holding one <path>. Params: to (a built-in shape: check cross circle square triangle star heart bolt arrow-up arrow-down play bulb, or #id of another path), color, dur (default 0.6). Needs MorphSVGPlugin
effects.形状/path-move: Move along an SVG path, turning to follow it (a paper plane, a data packet, a delivery route). Put it on the moving element. Params: path=#path id (required), dur (default 1.6), rotate=0 (no turning), draw=1 (draw the path as it goes), from / to (which part of the path, 0–1). Needs MotionPathPlugin
effects.形状/wiggle: A springy wiggle that settles (when something is called out, mocked or goes wrong). Params: n (how many swings, default 6), amp (degrees, default 8), dur (default 0.8), prop=rotation|x. Needs CustomEase + CustomWiggle
effects.数据/reorder: A ranking changes: the children of a column (or row) slide to their new places; the one that climbs grows slightly. Put it on the list container. Params: order (the new order as original positions separated by /, e.g. 3/1/2), dur (default 0.8)
effects.立体/pose-3d: 3D pose transition: moves a `phone3d`, `card3d`, `box3d` or card to target 3D angles and Z-height while shifting and diffusing its floor shadow. Params: ry / rx / rz, z, s, x / y, dur
effects.立体/flip-3d: Mid-air 3D flip: lifts a `card3d` (or `.front`/`.back` badge) in Z, flips 180° in air with dynamic shadow spread, and lands back on the white desk. Params: lift (default 110), dur (default 0.72)
effects.立体/deal-arc: Curved deck deal: deals thick cards from a stacked pile out along a 3D horseshoe or fan arc on `data-make="deck3d"`. Param: dur (default 1.1)
effects.立体/box-drop: 3D box gravity drop: drops a 6-face `box3d` onto the white surface with settle bounce and contact shadow compression. Params: drop (default 220), dur (default 0.68)
effects.立体/layer-explode: Exploded 3D stack: separates compressed plates vertically on `data-make="layers3d"` while drawing dashed corner guides and horizontal callout lines. Param: dur (default 0.9)
effects.立体/layer-focus: Focus layer i: lifts and highlights layer i (1..N from bottom; 0 restores all) on `data-make="layers3d"` while dimming other layers cleanly. Params: i, dur
effects.立体/rig-focus: Multi-mockup 3D focus shift: rotates item i (1..N; 0 restores ensemble) toward the camera and steps it forward in Z while angling siblings back. Params: i, s (default 1.06), dur
effects.立体/wall-pull: 3D card wall pull-back / push-in: pulls back from a flat close-up on the center card to a tilted 3D floating card matrix on `data-make="wall3d"` (`dir=in` pushes in). Params: dur (default 1.25), zoom (default 2.3)
effects.立体/float-pop: White-studio Z-pop: pops floating pills (`.fx-float-pill`) or score cards (`.fx-score-card`) forward in Z with soft studio elevation shadow. Param: dur (default 0.46)
effects.立体/flap-to: Mechanical split-flap advance: flips tiles on `data-make="flap3d"` to `to` (or `data-to`; write `_` for commas inside params, e.g. `10_000+`). Params: to, dur (default 0.36), stagger (default 0.06)
effects.立体/deck-gather: Gather deck back into a stack: sweeps spread/curved cards on `data-make="deck3d"` back into a neat thick deck brick. Param: dur (default 0.85)
effects.立体/letter-shuffle: Poker letter-tile shuffle: bounces `data-make="letterdeck"` tiles and flips `{highlighted}` character cards red with a playful tilt. Param: dur (default 0.55)
effects.立体/sleeve-draw: Draw thick deck from slipcase: slides the 3D outer box of `data-make="sleeve3d"` aside while drawing out the inner stack of cards. Param: dur (default 0.9)
effects.立体/grid-hero: Grid card Z-promotion: elevates card i (1..N; 0 restores) from a grid into center-stage foreground while softening surrounding cards. Params: i, s (default 1.65), dur
effects.立体/carousel-next: Tabletop Polaroid carousel: advances `data-make="carousel3d"` to card i (or `steps` ahead) while rippling the bottom poker hand. Params: i, steps, dur
effects.立体/card-storm: 3D card vortex storm: swirls child cards along a 3D spiral with foreground depth-of-field blur (great for information overload). Params: dur (default 2.6), r (default 320)
effects.立体/slab-shatter: 3D monolith domino & shatter: topples `data-make="slabs3d"` thick slabs into one another and blasts them into tumbling 3D shards. Param: dur (default 1.35)
effects.立体/coin-drop: 3D coin / chip toss & bounce: drops thick metallic `data-make="coins3d"` with 3D spin and tightening floor shadows. Param: dur (default 0.78)
effects.立体/polaroid-eject: Polaroid slot eject + progress bar: slides a `card3d` Polaroid out from above and fills its bottom progress bar to 100%. Param: dur (default 0.9)
effects.立体/board-lay: Tilt board into 3D timeline: lays `data-make="timeline3d"` back 56° onto the desk while popping clip cards upright and sweeping the playhead. Param: dur (default 1.2)
effects.立体/stack-print: Paper stack print + decay bar: stacks printed sheets onto `data-make="paperstack"` while draining the freshness meter to `to%`. Params: to (default 62), dur (default 1.4)
effects.立体/lock-callouts: Viewfinder lock + multi-leader callouts: snaps 4 corner brackets onto `data-make="callouts3d"` and draws horizontal leader lines. Param: dur (default 0.7)
effects.立体/pin-move: Timeline pin advance: slides the red `YOU ARE HERE` pin across `data-make="youarehere"` from `from` to `to` (0–1). Params: from, to, dur
effects.立体/phone-split: Hero phone center-to-split: starts with the 3D phone centered large, then glides it aside to reveal its companion card. Param: dur (default 0.78)
effects.立体/screen-pop: On-screen slice pop-out: peels a highlighted row (`.fx-pop-slice` or `to=#id`) out of a device screen along +Z with deep shadow. Params: to, s (default 1.12), dur
effects.立体/phone-wave: 3D phone wave lineup: ripples a row of `phone3d` mockups upright in a staggered 3D domino wave. Params: dur (default 0.65), stagger (default 0.08)
effects.立体/cal-flip: 30-day calendar card flip + counter surge: flips all tiles of `data-make="calgrid3d"` while rolling the top KPI counter to `to`. Params: to (default 18862), dur (default 1.6)
effects.立体/bubble-pop3d: 3D off-screen chat bubble pop: launches `.fx-pop-bub` bubbles out of a tilted phone screen into layered Z-space. Param: dur (default 0.5)
effects.立体/cta-click: White-pill cursor click + confetti: flies cursor onto `data-make="ctabar"`, clicks button to completed state and bursts confetti. Param: dur (default 0.9)
effects.立体/desk-invert: White desk ⇄ dark gold grid invert: flips the desk surface to dark charcoal-gold grid (`mode=reset` restores white desk). Param: mode=dark|reset
effects.转场/card-wipe: 3D giant poker-card lens wipe (works in both normal scenes and `data-world`): sweeps an oversized double-sided 3D card right across the camera to reveal the next scene. Params: dur (default 0.78), emblem (default A), color
